review_text: Exit load charges are not explained anywhere in the app before redemption. I was surprised by a deduction I did not expect.
Login OTP is not coming on my registered number. Tried 5 times. Support is not responding.
SIP deduction happened but units not reflecting. Worried about my money.
The expense ratio for SBI Large Cap Fund Direct is not shown clearly. I had to check AMFI separately.
Why is there no clear breakdown of expense ratio? I want to see all charges upfront before investing.
Good app overall but fee structure is not transparent. Exit load and expense ratio should be on the fund page.
My SIP failed this month even though my bank account had sufficient balance. No notification received.
I redeemed SBI ELSS thinking the 3-year lock-in was done but an exit load was still charged. No warning shown.
Exit load deducted on partial redemption. The percentage was not displayed before I confirmed the transaction.
Expense ratio for regular vs direct plan difference is not visible. Misleading for new investors.
The total cost of holding a fund — TER, exit load, transaction fees — should be one clear number. It is not.
App works well but the fee structure is opaque. I want to see all charges shown upfront on the investment page.
SIP mandate not activating even after 10 days of bank registration. No status update in app.
Password reset not working. Stuck in a loop. Had to call support.
Nominee update screen shows a blank page after submitting documents. Very frustrating.
Capital gains statement download fails every time. Need it for tax filing urgently.
Exit load for SBI Small Cap Fund should be shown before confirming redemption, not after.
The expense ratio changed last quarter but there was no notification. I found out only on the AMFI site.
Would give 5 stars if the fee components — exit load, expense ratio, stamp duty — were shown in one place.
Login keeps timing out. Very bad experience on Android 14.
OTP not received on email as backup either. Phone also not working. Locked out for two days.
Statement download works but the format is confusing for tax purposes.
SIP missed 3 months in a row due to mandate issues.
Fee transparency could be much better. Expense ratio and exit load should be on the fund summary card.
Nominee update submitted 4 times and keeps getting rejected without a reason given.
